message: Start new project with NFT idea
Scaffolded Omnichain NFT Agent Gallery: AgentONFT721 (OApp + ERC721) with burn-and-mint cross-chain bridging via LayerZero V2, Gallery marketplace with atomic buyAndBridge. 9/9 tests passing.
Created README, CLAUDE.md, interactive architecture visualization with generative art gallery simulation, and how-it-works page with tabbed transaction flows.
Deployed to testnets. Base Sepolia: AgentONFT721 (0xD4Ef...) + Gallery (0x0D92...). Arbitrum Sepolia: AgentONFT721 (0xEBe4...). Wired peers. Minted 3 NFTs, listed 1 on Gallery.

Built autonomous gallery agent with creative feedback loop. Epoch-based system: creates art in 6 styles, monitors sales, updates popularity scores, reprices stale listings -30%, creates more of popular styles with +50% demand premium. 20% exploration rate to discover new demand.

Assessed win probability. Identified creative feedback loop as key differentiator — the agent IS the artist, not just a minting script. It develops taste through market data. Renamed project to Atelier — Autonomous art, any chain.

Created animated Creative Loop visualization showing 2 epochs with market learning, popularity bars, NFT card status transitions, and demand premium pricing. Built SVG banner. Verified all 3 contracts on Sourcify.

Iterated on generative art styles — explored Picasso portraits, cosmic entities, solar system planets, settled on abstract generative with varied shapes (bokeh, triangles, rings, curves, grid, mixed).
Published to The Synthesis hackathon. Tracks: SuperRare Partner Track, ERC-8183 Open Build, Synthesis Open Track.
